text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's not bad, but... the effects could 
probably be made simpler. And the cuts 
too—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. You're right. If it caught your 
attention, you've gotta be particular 
about it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♡ I wonder if everyone will like it? 
Our new opening video...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You ended up staying up 
late into the night...
